text: I've only been using the app for three days but it has already helped me make improvements so far :) It's stopped me from skipping 'less essential' steps from my morning routine like taking my vitamins, doing Duolingo and exercising, and since I can see how long it takes I've been able to get up on time instead of rushing around and playing catchup all day! I haven't been able to make use of all my routines yet due to my irregular schedule (I'm a shift worker) but I'm excited to try them out!
